Top-line: inbound from YC-backed B2B SaaS startup building in-app chat assistant for their CRM-add-on. Self-serve signup last month; used free credits, ran basic tests. They care about streaming (partial tokens), low first-byte latency, predictable per-token costs. Preference: start on Hosted API (self-serve) then evaluate Dedicated if usage grows.

Key quotes: "We need replies to start showing in under 200ms for live UX" — CTO (Aria Lopez). "If streaming + batching reduces cost, we can expand" — Head of Product.

Tech constraints / requirements:
- Primary workload: multi-turn in-app chat with embeddings for context + short summarization of convo.
- Latency targets: first token <200ms ideally, median response end-to-end <700ms for 1-2 turn replies.
- Throughput: initial 150 concurrent active users, ramp to 2k over 6 months; typical session length 3-5 messages.
- Model preferences: open-ish models; will consider Redwood-verified small-medium models with streaming support; cost-sensitive vs fixed quality.
- Routing/fallback: want lightweight fallback to cheaper quantized variant on overload; region: us-east priority.
- Security: SOC2 preferred, SSO/SAML for staging; audit logs required for compliance review; data retention 30-90 days.
